name: An Unexpected Turn of Events
source:
You finally confess to your crush, but sadly, she rejects you in the most harsh and brutal way! After school, you encounter a middle-aged woman named Maki who is running away from a scary man. You take her to a restaurant and begin becoming close. Little did you or Maki know that this would be the start of the strange but lovely events surrounding both of you.

[From [url=https://allforone124.itch.io/an-unexpected-turn-of-events]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你终于向暗恋的人表白了，但可悲的是，她以最严厉、最残酷的方式拒绝了你！放学后，你遇到了一位名叫真纪的中年妇女，她正在逃离一个可怕的男人。你带她去一家餐馆并开始变得亲近。你和真希几乎不知道这将是围绕你们俩的奇怪但可爱的事件的开始。

[来自[url=https://allforone124.itch.io/an-unexpected-turn-of-events]itch.io[/url]]
